name: Prismari Charm
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Surveil 2, then draw a card.
• Prismari Charm deals 1 damage to each of one or two targets.
• Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
blocked_sentences: • Prismari Charm deals 1 damage to each of one or two targets.

needs.what: a caster-sized mode-owned target (`kind: "any", count: 2, up_to: true, min_count: 1, mode: 1`) on a mode that is NOT the last to own a target, when the top-level choose_mode is "choose one" (`count: 1`, no or_more/up_to): only one mode's specs are ever declared, so a later mode's target (here mode 2's "target nonland permanent") can never follow the variable-size refs in the same declaration
needs.why_existing_wont_do: loader.targets._check_mode_targets / _ends_every_declaration now admit an up_to mode-owned spec, but only when no later mode owns a target -- it ignores the choose_mode's count, so it refuses this card although a choose-one cast declares exactly one mode's specs; a card-level up_to target would be declared under every mode (and is refused beside mode-owned ones), and splitting the bullet into one-target and two-target modes changes the printed mode list
